pick.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
pick.why: $0 for every site, no proxy/DNS change required, no personal data collected
pick.free_limits: Free; site/retention/sampling limits not stated on the page

alts.name: Umami
alts.free_limits: Cloud Hobby 100k events/mo, 1 site, 6-month retention; Pro $20/mo; self-host free

alts.name: PostHog Web Analytics
alts.why: No extra tool; counts against 1M events

candidates.name: Plausible
candidates.verdict: Cloud is paid; CE is AGPL-3.0 (v3.2.1 2026-06-01)

candidates.name: GoatCounter

decision: Cloudflare Web Analytics is free for any number of sites, needs no DNS change and collects no personal data, so most marketing sites need no cookie banner for it. Switch to Umami (or PostHog web analytics) when you need custom events and goals on marketing pages.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
